mapper.insert: INSERT INTO social_location_user_restrictions (user_id, strike_count, status, blocked_until, reason_code, reason_message, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{strikeCount}, #{status}, #{blockedUntil}, #{reasonCode}, #{reasonMessage}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET strike_count = EXCLUDED.strike_count, status = EXCLUDED.status, blocked_until = EXCLUDED.blocked_until, reason_code = EXCLUDED.reason_code, reason_message = EXCLUDED.reason_message, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at

INSERT INTO social_location_submission_events (id, user_id, job_id, source_url, event_type, reason_code, details, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{jobId}, #{sourceUrl}, #{eventType}, #{reasonCode}, CAST(#{details} AS jsonb), #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM social_location_submission_events WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
